description: This file defines a comprehensive VC (Verifiable Credential) verification system within a CLI package, including structures for results, issues, and detailed verification methods for execution VCs, workflow VCs, and associated integrity, security, and compliance checks.

classes.name: EnhancedVCVerifier
classes.description: Provides methods for comprehensive verification of VC chains, execution VCs, workflow VCs, and associated verification results.

classes.name: VerificationIssue
classes.description: Represents specific issues found during verification with severity, component, and description.

classes.name: ComprehensiveVerificationResult
classes.description: Aggregates detailed verification outcomes including validity, scores, issues, and specific verification sub-results.

classes.name: WorkflowVerification
classes.description: Contains results for workflow-level verification checks.

classes.name: IntegrityCheckResults
classes.description: Holds results for various integrity verifications performed.

classes.name: SecurityAnalysis
classes.description: Provides results and insights for security-related verification aspects.

classes.name: ComplianceChecks
classes.description: Contains results for compliance and audit verification.

methods.name: VerifyEnhancedVCChain
methods.description: Performs comprehensive verification of a given VC chain, including execution VCs, workflow VC, integrity, security, and compliance checks.

methods.name: verifyExecutionVCComprehensive
methods.description: Verifies an individual execution VC against multiple integrity, signature, and structural checks.

methods.name: verifyWorkflowVC
methods.description: Performs verification on a workflow VC including signature, component consistency, timestamps, statuses, and chain integrity.

methods.name: performIntegrityChecks
methods.description: Conducts various integrity checks across the VC chain.

methods.name: performSecurityAnalysis
methods.description: Analyzes security aspects such as key validation, signature strength, and tamper evidence.

methods.name: performComplianceChecks
methods.description: Checks W3C compliance and other standards for the VC chain.

methods.name: verifyVCSignature
methods.description: Verifies the cryptographic signature of a VC document using its issuer’s DID resolution.

methods.name: validateTimestamp
methods.description: Validates that a timestamp string conforms to the RFC3339 format.

methods.name: validateVCStructure
methods.description: Ensures that the VC structure contains all required fields.

methods.name: checkExecutionVCMetadataConsistency
methods.description: Checks consistency of critical metadata between execution VC and its VC document.

methods.name: checkComponentVCConsistency
methods.description: Checks that the component VC list in the workflow matches individual execution VCs.

methods.name: checkTimestampConsistency
methods.description: Checks for internal timestamp consistency within the VC chain.

methods.name: checkStatusConsistency
methods.description: Checks consistency of the execution status across VCs and metadata.

methods.name: detectTamperEvidence
methods.description: Detects signs of tampering in execution VCs.

methods.name: checkW3CCompliance
methods.description: Verifies if a VC document complies with W3C standards based on context entries.

methods.name: calculateOverallScore
methods.description: Calculates an overall verification score based on issues and security analysis.

methods.name: isStatusConsistent
methods.description: Checks if execution status values are consistent, accounting for system status normalization.
